Agricultural University Lam And

 And

Seshamamba And Others ...Respondent(S)
Counsel for the Appellant(s):SRI. Yella Reddy Rajanala (Sc For Angrau) Counsel for the
Respondents: Kishore Kumar. A The Court made the following Judgment:
1) Today the learned Counsel for the Appellant University has placed a copy of the
proceedings, dated 21.02.2024, bearing Memo No.A2/752/TA/2023-24, whereby the
Respondent has been continued as Part -Time Teaching Associate in the Department of Food Safety & Quality Assurance. 
The Registrar Acharya N.G Ranga ... vs Dr Burla Sunitha Venkata Seshamamba on 21 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34756760/ 
1 2) The learned Counsel for the 1st Respondent would take offence to the use of the words "hourly basis" in the second line of the unnumbered second paragraph. The relevance of which is not obvious. 
3) The learned Counsel for the Appellants would submit that the 1st Respondent is being paid a consolidated sum of Rs.54,000/- on monthly basis and hence the use of the words "hourly basis" is mischievous. This court of the considered opinion that,
consideration of the aforesaid contention at this stage could lead to observations of the merits of the Petitioners claims which are pending adjudication before the learned Single Judge and which this Court would not venture at this interlocutory stage.
4) In view of the orders passed and placed before this Court today, we are of the opinion that the entire appeal, which is directed against the interim order would not survive for consideration on merits. 
5) In that view of the matter, the Writ Appeal stands disposed of as not surviving for consideration. There shall be no order as to costs. 
6) This Court has not entered upon to adjudicate the facts of the case and it is left open to the discretion and wisdom of the learned Single Judge. Be that as it may, we request the learned Single Judge to consider expeditious disposal of the Writ Petition in the event either of the parties makes a request for early hearing. 
7) In view of todays order, earlier show-cause notice stands withdrawn. 
8) Copy of this Judgment shall forthwith be furnished to the Registrar (Judicial).
9) As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed. 
_________________ G.NARENDAR, J _____________________________ V. GOPALA KRISHNA RAO, J Date: 21.02.2024 Sm.../... 
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE G.NARENDAR AND THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE VENUTHURUMALLI GOPALA KRISHNA RAO Date: 21.02.2024 Sm.
